Common AC Fan Motor Problems

Recognizing the signs of a failing fan motor can save you from bigger repair bills. Here are some common issues we fix daily.

  • Noisy AC Fan Motor Repair: Humming, buzzing, or rattling sounds often point to a failing motor or loose parts.
  • AC Fan Not Working Repair: If the fan doesn’t start at all, it could be the motor, capacitor, or a wiring issue.
  • AC Fan Running Slow Vadodara: A sluggish fan reduces cooling efficiency and can be caused by a faulty motor or capacitor.
